test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following leaders of Indian Freedom Movement gave the slogan ‘Freedom is my birthright and I shall have it’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bal Gangadhar Tilak.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak **gave the slogan **'Freedom is my birthright and I Shall have it'.**
 
• Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak **roused the Indian people and injected fresh life into our liberation cause with his electrifying phrase, "Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it."**
 
• Bal Gangadhar Tilak **worked valiantly to aid the country's independence** from British domination.
 
• Bal Gangadhar Tilak,** a member of the Lal-Bal-Pal troika.**
 
• He was** dubbed the "Father of Indian Unrest" by British colonial rulers.**
 
• Lokmanya Tilak **founded and published two newspapers: **
 
 
• **The (Marathi) Kesari**
 
• **The (English) Mahratta.**
 
 
 
• To criticize the colonial overlords, he used his pen as a weapon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Personality**
 **Famous sayings**
 
 

 **Bal Gangadhar Tilak**
 "If God is put up with untouchability, I will not call him God."
 
 

 **Lala Lajpat Rai**
 “Defeat and failure are sometimes necessary steps of victory.”
 
 

 **Subhash Chandra Bose**
 “Freedom is not given - it is taken” 
 
 

 **Gopalkrishna Gokhale**
 "No taxation without representation"
